reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
), grid AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with a budget
  SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, COALESCE(m.spend_eur, 0) AS spend_eur
  FROM budget_monthly b
  LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.channel_id = b.channel_id AND m.month = b.month
  WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-01'
)
SELECT channel_id, month, spend_eur,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 3
       THEN ROUND(AVG(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2)
  END AS avg_spend_3m
FROM grid

SELECT g.channel_id, g.month, g.spend_eur,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 3 THEN ROUND(AVG(p.spend_eur), 2) END AS avg_spend_3m
FROM grid g
JOIN grid p ON p.channel_id = g.channel_id AND p.month BETWEEN g.month - INTERVAL 2 MONTH AND g.month
GROUP BY g.channel_id, g.month, g.spend_eur

WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
), grid AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with a budget
  SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, COALESCE(m.spend_eur, 0) AS spend_eur
  FROM budget_monthly b
  LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.channel_id = b.channel_id AND m.month = b.month
  WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-01'
), w AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with a budget
  SELECT channel_id, month, spend_eur,
    LAG(spend_eur, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_1,
    LAG(spend_eur, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_2
  FROM grid
)
SELECT channel_id, month, spend_eur, ROUND((spend_eur + prev_1 + prev_2) / 3, 2) AS avg_spend_3m
FROM w
